intro_2: If a key never reaches Windows, it won't appear here.
unknown_device_note: Windows did not provide a device handle (hDevice=0) or the device could not be resolved at the moment. This can happen with some HID/Bluetooth devices.
tt_vendor_id: Vendor ID (VID) identifies the manufacturer of the device.
tt_product_id: Product ID (PID) identifies the device model within the vendor.
tt_interface: Interface (MI_XX) is the function/interface number for composite devices.
tt_guid: GUID identifies the device interface class used by Windows to route this kind of input.
tt_path: Raw device path provided by Windows Raw Input. Useful for diagnostics and matching devices.
tt_handle: Raw Input device handle. Sometimes Windows sends 0 (unknown).
tt_transport: Transport is inferred from the device path (USB / dongle / Bluetooth).
tt_vkey: Virtual-Key code: logical key identifier used by Windows (VK_*).
tt_flags: Flags: extended keys (E0/E1) and break (release) indicator for scan codes.
tt_msg: Windows message type: key press/release (and system key variants).
